We are looking for a experienced SEO executive to optimize website content, improve keyword rankings, enhance website structure, and implement on-page SEO strategies to increase organic traffic and search engine visibility.

* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and communication skills.

title: Manager, Engineering, Enterprise Data Platform
description:
As a Data Engineering Manager within the Enterprise Data Platform team at PitchBook, you will lead a team of skilled data engineers responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines, managing large-scale data models, and ensuring the quality, availability, and performance of enterprise data assets. This leadership role combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and people management to enable PitchBook’s data-driven decision-making and analytics capabilities.

  

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Technology & Engineering, Product, Sales, Marketing, Research, Finance, and Administration to deliver robust, scalable data solutions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a strong background in modern data platforms, cloud architecture, and team development—someone passionate about empowering teams and improving data capabilities across the organization. A core part of this role is shaping an analytics environment that is built for AI agents as much as for people. Our analysts, executives and AI agents should all query the same governed, documented, well-described data and get the same answers. You will lead the team to make that real, with semantic layers, governed metrics, rich metadata, agent-safe access, and evaluation of agent output, and in using agents to build faster and with higher quality.

  
  

This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership role: you will guide architectural decisions, mentor engineers, collaborate with cross-functional leaders, and contribute to building next-generation data and AI capabilities at PitchBook. You will exhibit a growth mindset, be willing to solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. If you love leading a team of passionate data engineers, building data-centric solutions, strive for excellence every day, are adaptable and focused, and believe work should be fun, come join us!

  

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, retain top talent and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Define and drive the data engineering roadmap aligned with enterprise data strategy and business objectives
* Collaborate with senior technology and business leaders to define data platform priorities, architecture, and long-term vision
* Promote a culture of innovation, operational rigor, and customer empathy within the data organization
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of high-quality data pipelines and ELT/ETL workflows across enterprise systems and PitchBook’s platform
* Ensure scalable, secure, and reliable data architectures using modern cloud technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Airflow, Kafka, Docker)
* Lead AI learning initiatives and integrate AI/ML-driven solutions into data products to enhance automation, predictive insights, and decision intelligence
* Champion data quality, governance, lineage, and compliance standards across the enterprise data ecosystem
* Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to optimize data storage, compute performance, and cost efficiency
Support career development through mentoring, skill-building, and performance feedback  

  

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles, including at least 2–3 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
* Proven experience designing and maintaining large-scale data architectures, pipelines, and data models in cloud environments (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, transformation, and automation
* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), and distributed messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)
* Strong knowledge of data governance, quality, and compliance frameworks
* Experience working with enterprise data sources (CRM, ERP, Marketing Automation, Financial Systems, etc.) is preferred
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms, model deployment, or data-driven automation is a strong plus
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business value
Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams and lead through change  

  

**Working Conditions**

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

title: Key Account Manager (KAM) – Flipkart & Myntra
description:
Job Description: Key Account Manager (KAM) – Flipkart & Myntra

**Department:** E-Commerce / Sales  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Industry:** Footwear / Fashion / Apparel / Lifestyle  
**Experience:** 3–7 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Head of E-Commerce / Business Head  
**Company:** Confidential / Hiring for a Client

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a result-oriented **Key Account Manager (KAM) – Flipkart & Myntra** to manage and grow the company's online marketplace business. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing brand accounts on Flipkart and Myntra, driving sales growth, optimizing product listings, planning promotional campaigns, managing inventory, and improving marketplace profitability.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end marketplace account management, commercial coordination, sales performance analysis, and building strong relationships with marketplace category managers and internal stakeholders.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Marketplace Account Management

* Manage day-to-day business operations and account relationships with Flipkart and Myntra.
* Coordinate with marketplace category managers, account managers, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop account-specific business plans to achieve sales and profitability targets.
* Identify opportunities for category expansion, product launches, and business growth.
* Resolve marketplace operational issues, escalations, and account-related concerns.

B. Sales Growth & Business Planning

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and GMV targets.
* Analyze sales trends, product performance, sell-through, and category growth.
* Plan and execute promotional activities, festive campaigns, and major marketplace sales events.
* Identify high-performing and underperforming SKUs and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor competitor pricing, assortment, discounts, and market positioning.

C. Catalogue & Product Listing Management

* Ensure accurate product listings, titles, descriptions, images, sizes, attributes, and pricing.
* Coordinate new product onboarding and SKU activation.
* Monitor product visibility, search rankings, ratings, reviews, and conversion performance.
* Work with catalogue and creative teams to improve product content and listing quality.
* Ensure timely resolution of listing errors and product suppression issues.

D. Inventory & Order Management

* Monitor inventory availability and coordinate replenishment with warehouse and supply chain teams.
* Maintain optimum stock levels for fast-moving products and key sizes.
* Track order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and stock-outs.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve inventory and fulfilment issues.
* Support demand forecasting and inventory planning for promotional events.

E. Pricing, Promotions & Profitability

* Plan pricing strategies and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate discount structures, commissions, advertising expenses, and promotional investments.
* Monitor account profitability and identify opportunities to improve contribution margins.
* Coordinate commercial negotiations and promotional funding with marketplace stakeholders.
* Track pending claims, deductions, payment reconciliations, and recoveries with Finance.

F. Reporting & Analytics

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly marketplace performance reports.
* Monitor GMV, net sales, average selling price, conversion rate, sell-through, and returns.
* Analyse campaign performance and advertising efficiency wherever applicable.
* Develop sales forecasts, performance dashboards, and management MIS.
* Present actionable insights and recommendations to management.

G. Internal Coordination

* Work closely with Marketing, Performance Marketing, Catalogue, Finance, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.
* Ensure alignment between sales forecasts, inventory availability, pricing, and promotional plans.
* Track key business deliverables and ensure timely execution.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in E-Commerce, Key Account Management, or Marketplace Management.
* **Hands-on experience managing Flipkart and Myntra accounts is strongly preferred.**
* Experience in footwear, apparel, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer goods is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of marketplace operations, sales planning, catalogue management, and commercial negotiations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, sales analytics, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and reporting.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales and GMV target achievement.
* Marketplace revenue growth and profitability.
* SKU onboarding and product assortment expansion.
* Inventory availability and stock-out reduction.
* Sell-through and conversion rate improvement.
* Promotional campaign performance and return on advertising spend, where applicable.
* Reduction in cancellations, returns, and operational issues.
* Timely settlement reconciliation and claim recovery.
* Accuracy and timeliness of marketplace reporting.

5. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be commercially driven, analytical, proactive, and comfortable managing marketplace business independently. Candidates with direct experience handling **both Flipkart and Myntra for a footwear, fashion, or apparel brand** will receive preference.

**Key Skills:** Flipkart Seller Hub, Myntra Marketplace Management, Key Account Management, E-Commerce Sales, GMV Growth, Catalogue Management, Pricing Strategy, Inventory Planning, Promotional Campaigns, Commercial Negotiation, MS Excel, Sales Analytics.

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

The Sensory Scientist designs and leads testing plans with scientific rigor, issues reports and creates actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

The Sensory Scientist collaborates with R&D, Marketing, Consumer Insights, Operations, and other internal and external partners on new products, processes, quality improvements and cost savings to drive McCain’s profitable growth.

As part of the Global Sensory and User Experience team, the Sensory Scientist also works with internal team members to expand McCain’s global sensory capabilities. This includes the optimization and standardization of sensory tools and the development of new or hybrid methods. It also includes developing new training materials, assessing and onboarding new vendors, identifying and closing gaps the company has in regard to its sensory needs, and contributing to investigations regarding the linkage between sensory methods or attribute intensities to instrumental test methods.

The position executes and reports sensory and consumer/customer research studies. As such, the Sensory Scientist builds and maintains strong relationships with core vendors, supervises the application of best scientific practices by such vendors and manages test costs and timelines.

This position is based in the McCain HO. About Earth Store

Earth Store is a growing consumer-focused business committed to building a scalable and financially sustainable organization. We believe in ownership, accountability, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making.

We are looking for a commercially minded FP&A Manager who can turn financial data into actionable business insights, improve profitability, strengthen financial planning, and support strategic decisions.

Role Overview

The FP&A Manager will lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and management reporting at Earth Store. The role will work closely with the Founder/CEO and department heads to monitor business performance, identify financial risks and opportunities, and drive profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who goes beyond preparing reports—someone who understands the business behind the numbers and proactively recommends what needs to change.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Planning & Budgeting

* Develop annual budgets, operating plans, and financial forecasts.
* Work with department heads to prepare and consolidate departmental budgets.
* Translate business goals into financial targets and measurable performance indicators.
* Monitor actual financial performance against budgets and identify variances.
* Update forecasts based on changing business conditions and performance trends.

2. Financial Analysis & Profitability

* Analyse revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, operating expenses, and EBITDA.
* Identify the key drivers of profitability and cost inefficiencies.
* Evaluate product, channel, and business-segment profitability.
* Analyse pricing, discounting, product costs, logistics expenses, and marketing expenditure.
* Recommend initiatives to improve margins, reduce costs, and increase operating efficiency.

3. Management Reporting & MIS

* Prepare accurate and timely monthly management reports and financial dashboards.
* Present financial performance, budget variances, risks, and opportunities to the leadership team.
* Develop relevant KPIs to track business and departmental performance.
* Convert financial data into clear, actionable business recommendations.
* Establish consistent reporting formats and performance review mechanisms.

4. Financial Forecasting & Modelling

* Build financial models for revenue, expenses, profitability, and cash flow.
* Develop best-case, base-case, and worst-case scenarios.
* Forecast financial performance and identify potential gaps against business targets.
* Evaluate new product launches, business expansion, and other growth initiatives.
* Conduct break-even, sensitivity, and return-on-investment analyses.

5. Business Partnering

* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Procurement, Operations, Warehouse, and HR teams.
* Evaluate departmental spending and financial performance.
* Analyse marketing ROI, sales performance, inventory costs, and operational expenses.
* Challenge assumptions and support department heads in making financially sound decisions.
* Drive accountability for budgets and business performance across functions.

6. Working Capital & Cash Flow Analysis

* Prepare cash flow forecasts and monitor projected cash requirements.
* Analyse inventory turnover, stock ageing, receivables, and payables.
* Identify opportunities to improve working capital efficiency.
* Assess the financial impact of inventory purchases, growth plans, and operating decisions.
* Highlight potential liquidity risks and recommend appropriate actions.

7. Strategic Decision Support

* Support the Founder/CEO in financial and commercial decision-making.
* Evaluate new business opportunities and investment proposals.
* Identify financial risks, growth opportunities, and potential profitability improvements.
* Present recommendations backed by financial data and business analysis.
* Support the development of long-term financial plans and growth strategies.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* CA, CMA, MBA Finance, or an equivalent finance qualification preferred.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial planning, business finance, or commercial finance.
* Experience in retail, e-commerce, D2C, FMCG, or consumer businesses is preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, profitability, and financial modelling.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Experience with financial dashboards and reporting tools; Power BI or similar tools is an advantage.
* Ability to work with large datasets and translate analysis into business recommendations.
* Strong communication, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is commercially aware, analytical, proactive, and comfortable working directly with senior leadership.

They should be able to explain why financial performance is changing, identify risks before they become problems, challenge assumptions constructively, and recommend practical actions that improve business outcomes.

We value ownership, problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to connect financial numbers with real business decisions.

Why Join Earth Store?

* Work closely with the Founder/CEO and influence business decisions.
* Build and improve financial planning and analysis processes.
* Take ownership of financial insights that directly impact business growth.
* Collaborate with multiple departments and understand the business end to end.
* Be part of a growing organization where initiative and accountability matter.

Solstice Advanced Materials is a leading global specialty materials company that advances science for smarter outcomes. Solstice offers high\-performance solutions that enable critical industries and applications, including refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging and more. Solstice is recognized for developing next\-generation materials through some of the industry's most renowned brands such as Solstice®, Genetron®, Aclar®, Spectra®, Fluka™, and Hydranal™. Partnering with over 3,000 customers across more than 120 countries and territories and supported by a robust portfolio of over 5,700 patents, Solstice’s approximately 4,000 employees worldwide drive innovation in materials science. For more information, visit Advanced Materials .

**Sales Planning \& Execution**

* Own territory revenue, gross margin, collections, and growth targets.
* Develop account plans for key pharmaceutical, CRO/CDMO, healthcare, academic, industrial, and analytical laboratory customers.
* Identify customer needs and promote relevant research chemicals and laboratory solutions.

* Ensure pricing discipline, payment compliance, and adherence to brand standards.

**About DGTL360**

We are looking for a senior SEO professional ready to step into a leadership role. As SEO Team Lead at DGTL360, you will be the strategic and operational backbone of our organic search practice — owning SEO outcomes across a portfolio of client accounts while leading, mentoring, and growing a team of SEO specialists.

This is not a purely executional role. You will be expected to set the SEO vision for each client, connect organic strategy to broader business goals, drive alignment across content, development, and performance teams, and represent SEO as a growth lever in client conversations. The right candidate combines deep technical SEO knowledge with strong people leadership and client management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. SEO Strategy \& Planning**

* Own the SEO strategy across an assigned portfolio of client accounts — from audit and discovery through to roadmap creation and quarterly planning.
* Develop customised organic search strategies for each client, aligned to their business goals, audience, and competitive landscape.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities across technical SEO, on\-page optimisation, content, and link acquisition to maximise organic visibility and traffic.
* Stay ahead of Google algorithm updates, search trends, and emerging SEO developments (AI search, SGE, zero\-click, etc.) and translate them into actionable recommendations.
* Build and present strategic SEO roadmaps to clients and internal stakeholders with clear timelines, KPIs, and expected outcomes.

**2\. Technical SEO Ownership**

* Lead comprehensive technical SEO audits covering site architecture, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, page speed, structured data, hreflang, and mobile usability.
* Work closely with the web development team to ensure SEO best practices are embedded in all website builds, migrations, and updates.
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues — including crawl budget waste, duplicate content, canonicalisation errors, redirect chains, and log file anomalies.
* Oversee implementation of schema markup, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and other technical configurations across client sites.
* Lead website migration projects with thorough pre\- and post\-migration SEO planning to protect and grow organic performance.

**3\. On\-Page SEO \& Content Strategy**

* Drive on\-page SEO excellence across client websites — including keyword mapping, meta optimisation, header structure, internal linking, and content gap analysis.
* Develop content strategies grounded in keyword research, search intent analysis, and competitive benchmarking.
* Collaborate with the content team to brief, review, and quality\-check SEO\-optimised content that serves both users and search engines.
* Build topical authority frameworks for clients by identifying pillar\-cluster opportunities and guiding content production accordingly.
* Conduct regular content audits to identify pages for improvement, consolidation, or removal based on performance data.

**4\. Off\-Page SEO \& Authority Building**

* Design and oversee ethical, white\-hat link acquisition strategies tailored to each client's niche and authority goals.
* Identify high\-quality link opportunities through digital PR, content partnerships, guest contributions, and industry directories.
* Monitor and manage backlink profiles using tools such as SEMrush — proactively disavowing toxic links where required.
* Build relationships with relevant publishers and content partners to support long\-term domain authority growth.

**5\. Analytics, Reporting \& Insights**

* Own SEO performance reporting across all client accounts — setting up dashboards in GA4, Google Search Console, and reporting tools (Looker Studio, etc.).
* Define and track meaningful SEO KPIs: organic sessions, keyword rankings, share of voice, click\-through rates, conversions from organic, and revenue attribution.
* Translate data into clear, client\-friendly insights and forward\-looking recommendations — connecting SEO performance to business outcomes.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with clients, presenting progress against goals and adjusting strategy based on data.
* Maintain a proactive approach to anomaly detection — flagging traffic drops, ranking volatility, or indexation issues early and responding swiftly.

**6\. Team Leadership \& Development**

* Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Senior SEO Specialists and Junior SEOs — setting clear goals, providing regular feedback, and supporting career growth.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, team reviews, and knowledge\-sharing sessions to build a high\-performance SEO culture.
* Delegate work effectively across the team based on skills, capacity, and client complexity.
* Establish team processes, SOPs, and quality benchmarks to ensure consistent, high\-quality output across all accounts.
* Champion continuous learning within the team — fostering a culture of curiosity, testing, and staying current with industry developments.

**7\. Client Management \& Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the primary SEO point of contact for assigned clients — building trusted, consultative relationships built on transparency and results.
* Lead client onboarding, strategy presentations, monthly review meetings, and QBRs.
* Coordinate seamlessly between the SEO team, content team, web development, PPC, and business development to deliver integrated, holistic digital strategies.
* Identify opportunities to grow client accounts through expanded scope, new services, or additional SEO investment.
* Ensure timely, accurate delivery of all client deliverables — audits, reports, recommendations, and content briefs.

**Skills \& QualificationsMandatory Requirements**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in SEO, with at least 2 years in a team lead or senior management role.
* Proven track record of managing and growing organic search performance across multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Hands\-on experience with leading SEO tools: Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio.
* Deep understanding of Google's ranking systems, core algorithm updates, and E\-E\-A\-T principles.

**Technical SEO**

* Expert\-level understanding of technical SEO: crawling, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, page speed optimisation, structured data, and log file analysis.
* Hands\-on experience managing website migrations with zero or minimal organic traffic loss.
* Proficiency in HTML, CSS basics, and working knowledge of JavaScript's impact on SEO.
* Familiarity with server\-side rendering, headless CMS architectures, and modern web development frameworks from an SEO perspective.

**Content \& On\-Page SEO**

* Strong command of keyword research methodologies, search intent mapping, and topical authority building.
* Experience briefing and collaborating with content writers to produce SEO\-optimised, high\-quality content.
* Ability to conduct comprehensive content audits and develop data\-backed content strategies.

**Leadership \& Communication**

* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop an SEO team with varying levels of experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to explain complex SEO concepts clearly to clients and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple accounts and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Client\-facing confidence with the ability to handle challenging conversations, manage expectations, and build long\-term partnerships.
* A postgraduate degree in Marketing, IT, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
